description: In inbox.rs fetch_actor_inbox, the actor document body is fetched via resp.json::<serde_json::Value>().await with no size cap, just like fetch_public_key. A malicious Follow sender can point to an actor URL that responds with a multi-gigabyte JSON document, causing the server to OOM. The 5-second timeout is insufficient to prevent this on a fast network.
title: fetch_actor_inbox has no response body size limit
